Name: Shadow for Mazes
Author: eduanttunes
Description:
[center]Do you like [b]maze maps?[/b] Try to add some extra difficulty with this "shadow".

The screen will become black with only a circular field of vision in the middle.

This is a mod useful for Maze maps. Some good examples are maps created by [url=https://youtube.com/eduanttunes]Edu Anttunes[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/unsurpassablez]﻿UnsurpassableZ.[/url]﻿

[size=5][b][u]HOW TO USE?[/u][/b][/size]

[b]Press the "L" key 5 times to toggle on/off the shadow. [/b]Don't tell your challenged friend.

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/evGtTYLtJkT4TAKP9z/giphy.gif[/img]﻿

[color=#ffff00][b]Important:[/b] [/color]It only works at Farm. Maze map not included.

Created by [b][url=https://youtube.com/eduanttunes]Edu Anttunes[/url]﻿[/b][/center]
